articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Ford’s China And Geely Partnerships Put Global Costs And Valuation In Focus. Ford Motor (NYSE:F) is pursuing deeper collaboration with Chinese automakers to set up joint ventures that would produce vehicles in the US with American firms retaining control. In Europe, Ford is in talks with Geely about using excess plant capacity and sharing technology, including autonomous driving systems.
